shared_elements: small repeated short strokes forming rows
justification: A depicts a single monumental anthropomorphic figure — head with brow and nose, torso bearing concentric ring/disc motifs, arms and a curving girdle band — whereas B shows a scatter of small boat-like forms with hull curves topped by rows of short vertical strokes, plus stray linear marks, with no figure at all. The only real correspondence is the generic use of shallow outline incision and curved arcs with repeated short strokes, which any carving tradition could produce independently; the subject matter (a body with symbolic emblems vs. repeated vessel signs on an open field) is entirely different.
